title: Great idea but does not work well in practice; I’m sorry I ordered this
text:
Great idea but does not work well in practice; I’m sorry I ordered this. The idea behind this clip is to insert the cup like rim into a plastic bag and then wrap the bag around it and clip it closed. However, in practice this does not work well at all.

This separates into two parts. I followed the instructions as per the video but found that the clip is almost impossible to close once the bag is wrapped around it and I tried a thin biodegradable bag. Also, the flip top is almost impossible to snap shut. In addition, unless the bag has a very narrow top, the act of folding it causes the contents to be difficult to dispense because of all the creases in the bag.

I think this is a great idea but is just not functional in practice and is way too cumbersome to use. This is another item for the garbage. I am so sorry I purchased this, even though my purchase winds up being at a discount. I am so disappointed.
